# MCP Servers

MECE inventory of MCP servers registered in `.mcp.json`.
Each server provides a namespace of tools exposed to Claude Code.

## Servers

| Name | Command | Args |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lore` | `bun` | `vendor/bearly/plugins/tribe/lore/server.ts` |
| `tty` | `bun` | `vendor/termless/packages/cli/src/cli.ts mcp` |

## How to add a new MCP server

```jsonc
// .mcp.json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "my-server": {
      "command": "bun",
      "args": ["path/to/server.ts"]
    }
  }
}
```
